        super().__init__(**kwargs)
    
    def object_preselection(self, variation):
        """
        Override: build MuonGood collection with pT > 15 GeV and |eta| < 2.4
        """
        muons = self.events.Muon
        muons_good = muons[
            (muons.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)
        ]
        self.events["MuonGood"] = muons_good
    
    def count_objects(self, variation):
        """
        Override: store number of selected muons per event
        """
        self.events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(self.events.MuonGood)
